video_title: Donte DiVincenzo's First Steps Back on the Court | Day Zero Episode Three

quotes.speaker: Martin O'Malley
quotes.summary_phrase: Dr. O'Malley on the critical recovery window for DiVincenzo
quotes.excerpt: 8 to 10 weeks is sort of crucial to rerupture time because people feel great.

text_blocks.speaker: Martin O'Malley
text_blocks.text: 8 to 10 weeks is sort of crucial to rerupture time because people feel great and then it's never anything on purpose. It's always an accident. It's always a slip, it's always a trip.

text_blocks.speaker: Donte DiVincenzo
text_blocks.text: I'm at that point right now and like you said where you feel like I could cheat. I took the crutches off yesterday.

quotes.speaker: Martin O'Malley
quotes.summary_phrase: Dr. O'Malley clears DiVincenzo for initial weight-bearing exercises
quotes.excerpt: If he wants, he can start doing stuff on the reverse slant, he can start doing stuff now.

text_blocks.speaker: Martin O'Malley
text_blocks.text: If he wants, he can start doing stuff on the reverse slant, he can start doing stuff now. You can do some squats with his foot down and stuff like that.

text_blocks.speaker: Donte DiVincenzo
text_blocks.text: So we can start. Okay, so I can stand on the slant board.

quotes.speaker: Donte DiVincenzo
quotes.summary_phrase: DiVincenzo on the next steps in his recovery process
quotes.excerpt: The next step for me is getting that information and just being able to push a little bit more.
quotes.quote: The next step for me is getting that information and just being able to push a little bit more. Being able to, obviously, I was going to push it regardless, but being able to push it in a sense of being safe and smart behind it, having the approval from Dr. O'Malley to take that next step to push it even more. I'm going to absolutely throw the kitchen sink at this thing.

quotes.speaker: Martin O'Malley
quotes.summary_phrase: Dr. O'Malley on the timeline for returning to play
quotes.excerpt: When you return to play is based on how you feel and how this whole thing goes.

text_blocks.speaker: Martin O'Malley
text_blocks.text: Then you're going to see how long it takes you to build up to come back to play. When you return to play is based on how you feel and how this whole thing goes.

quotes.speaker: Donte DiVincenzo
quotes.summary_phrase: DiVincenzo on his alignment with Dr. O'Malley's recovery timeline
quotes.excerpt: He has confidence in the timeline that I have. I think we both aligned.
quotes.quote: He has confidence in the timeline that I have. I think we both aligned, so it's a good sign for sure.
